donor_fund_entries_one_adjustment_per_or.name: donor_fund_entries_one_adjustment_per_order
donor_fund_entries_one_adjustment_per_or.where: kind = 'adjustment' AND order_id IS NOT NULL

donor_fund_entries_sign.name: donor_fund_entries_sign
donor_fund_entries_sign.value: ("donor_fund_entries"."kind" = 'top_up' AND "donor_fund_entries"."amount_zar" > 0) OR ("donor_fund_entries"."kind" IN ('spend', 'sweep') AND "donor_fund_entries"."amount_zar" < 0) OR ("donor_fund_entries"."kind" = 'adjustment' AND "donor_fund_entries"."amount_zar" > 0)

monthly_report_closed_requires_admin_sig.name: monthly_report_closed_requires_admin_sig
monthly_report_closed_requires_admin_sig.value: status != 'closed' OR admin_sig IS NOT NULL

emergency_requires_approval.name: emergency_requires_approval
emergency_requires_approval.value: kind != 'emergency' OR status = 'pending_admin_approval' OR admin_approved_by IS NOT NULL
